notes: The tagent OAuth App is registered, and its client id ships inside every binary: the "Connect with GitHub" button now appears out of the box — no TAGENT_GH_CLIENT_ID, no config, no token hunting. Along the way a fatal bug surfaced: the device-code request went to github.github.com (a bad string replace), so v0.25.0’s flow never actually reached GitHub. That is fixed, the device page now opens with ?user_code= prefill where possible, and client-id resolution is now env → config → bundled — your own github.clientId finally overrides the built-in one.
